occurrences.text: Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
